document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
In a series of friezes, you notice that a strange, mucous-looking 
creature has been partly chiseled away. The creature seems to 
resemble the ancient slave race of the “Old Ones” you’ve read 
about in dubious tomes of lore. You think you remember the 
name given to them: shoggoths. Return to 236.
(236)
